values.draft: Saved but not approved. It can still be edited or deleted, and nothing runs with it yet.
values.in_review: Submitted for review and not yet approved. It can still be edited or deleted.
values.approved: Approved and in use. It can no longer change: to change it, save a new version.
values.retired: Replaced by a newer approved version. Kept as the record of what was used.

values.planned: Created; its sources are queued to be searched.
values.running: Its sources are being searched now.
values.degraded: Every source has stopped, but at least one did not finish cleanly. It can be frozen only by accepting the gap.
values.frozen: Closed. What it found has become candidates, and it can feed a release.
values.failed: Stopped without results that can be used. Start a new run.
values.cancelled: Stopped by a person before it finished.

source_outcome.title: Source outcomes in a discovery run

values.pending: This source has not answered yet.
values.succeeded: The source returned every result for the query.
values.succeeded_empty: The source answered completely, and nothing matched the query.
values.degraded_partial: The source returned some results, then stopped before the end.
values.rate_limited_retryable: The source asked us to slow down. It is tried again after the wait it gave.
values.authentication_required: The source refused the request without valid credentials. An admin must configure its key.
values.policy_blocked: Our own policy forbids searching this source for this scope.
values.source_unavailable_retryable: The source did not answer (down or unreachable). It is tried again automatically.
values.invalid_query: The source rejected the query as written. Fix the query in a new scope version.
values.failed_permanent: The source failed in a way retrying will not fix.
values.cancelled: The search of this source was stopped before it finished.

duplicate_reason.title: Why two records are proposed as one paper

values.title_author_year_similarity: Their titles, authors and years are very similar, but no shared DOI, PMID or PMCID proves it. A person decides.

values.unreviewed: Nobody has decided yet whether this paper belongs in the collection.
values.included: In the collection. Its full text is planned for acquisition.
values.included_uncertain: Included, but marked as uncertain for a second look.
values.excluded: Recorded as out of scope. It will not enter a release.

values.unresolved: Not yet matched to the records other sources hold for the same paper.
values.resolved: Matched: every source's record for this paper is joined into one work.
values.conflict: Its identifiers contradict each other. It cannot enter a release until a person resolves it.
values.merged: Merged into another work that represents the same paper.
values.split: Separated from a work it had wrongly been joined to.

values.none: No retraction or correction is recorded.
values.retracted: The paper has been retracted. It is excluded from new releases, and answers that cited it are flagged.
values.correction_issued: A correction has been published for this paper.

values.open: Waiting for a decision: the two records may be the same paper.
values.merged: Merged: the two records are now one paper.
values.dismissed: A reviewer decided these are two different papers.
values.superseded: No longer a question: another merge already joined or replaced one side.

values.scope_approved: The scope version was approved and frozen: from here on it cannot change.
values.discovery_frozen: A discovery run under the scope was frozen, so its records became candidates.
values.reconciled: The frozen run's records were grouped into papers and scored by the scope's rules.
values.scope_rules_applied: A steward re-applied an approved scope version's rules to the candidates.
values.relevance_by_filter: A steward included or excluded every candidate matching a filter.
values.merge_by_rule: A steward merged every duplicate pair a merge rule accepted.
values.relevance_set: A reviewer included or excluded one paper.
values.merged: A reviewer merged two records of the same paper.
values.dismissed: A reviewer marked a proposed pair as two different papers.

values.unplanned: Included, but no plan to fetch its full text has been made yet.
values.planned: Routes to fetch the full text are planned and being tried.
values.acquired: The full text was fetched and passed its checks.
values.assisted: No permitted route returned it. A person can upload a copy the lab is entitled to.
values.unavailable: No legal copy is available; only the metadata is kept.
values.failed: Every route failed. A person can still upload a copy.

values.pending: This route has not answered yet.
values.acquired: This route returned the full text.
values.already_available: A copy was already stored, so nothing was fetched again.
values.not_found: This route has no copy of the paper.
values.metadata_only: This route describes the paper but offers no full text.
values.rate_limited_retryable: The source asked us to slow down. It is tried again after the wait it gave.
values.source_unavailable_retryable: The source did not answer. It is tried again automatically.
values.authentication_required: The source needs credentials we do not have configured. An admin must add them.
values.entitlement_required: The paper needs a subscription or licence this route does not have. Upload an authorised copy.
values.robots_or_policy_blocked: The site's robots rules or our policy forbid fetching from it.
values.licence_not_permitted: The paper's licence does not allow us to store this copy.
values.identity_mismatch: The file returned is a different paper from the one requested.
values.invalid_content: The file returned is not a usable document (for example an error page).
values.malware_quarantined: The file failed the malware scan and was quarantined.
values.too_large: The file is larger than the configured limit.
values.assisted_required: No permitted automatic route remains. A person must upload a copy.
values.failed_permanent: This route failed in a way retrying will not fix.
values.cancelled: The attempt was stopped before it finished.

bulk_import.title: Files in a bulk PDF import

values.matched: Would be imported: it matches the paper waiting for it. Shown only by Check matches; nothing is stored yet.
values.imported: Matched and stored; the paper continues to parsing.
values.unmatched: No waiting paper matches it. Assign it by hand.
values.ambiguous: It could belong to more than one waiting paper. Assign it by hand.
values.blocked: Stored, but it did not pass the malware scan. A steward must resolve it before it is used.
values.rejected: Matched, but refused by a check: rights, integrity, identity, size or file type.

values.pending: Automatic validation has not run yet.
values.valid: Passed automatic validation: unit, type and evidence check out. It can be accepted.
values.invalid: Failed automatic validation. It cannot be accepted; correct it or reject it.

abstention.title: Why a value was or was not reported

values.reported: The paper reports this value, and the evidence passage shows it.
values.not_reported_after_complete_search: The whole paper was searched and does not report this value.
values.not_searched_budget: Not searched: the extraction budget ran out first.
values.not_searched_policy: Not searched: policy does not allow this content to be processed.
values.source_unavailable: Not searched: the full text was not available.
values.parse_quality_insufficient: Not searched: the parsed text was too poor to read reliably.
values.ambiguous_multiple_values: The paper gives several candidate values and it is not clear which applies.
values.conflicting_values: The paper gives values that contradict each other.
values.extractor_abstained: The extractor declined to give a value.
values.not_applicable: This value does not apply to this paper or experiment.
values.policy_redacted: A value exists but is withheld by policy.

proposal_source.title: Where a proposed value came from

values.deterministic_parser: Read by a fixed rule from structured data, such as a table or metadata.
values.model: Proposed by a language model from the paper's text.
values.legacy_import: Carried over from the previous system.

values.draft: Assembled from approved material and not yet validated.
values.validated: Its gates passed. It waits for a person to approve it; nothing is indexed or served yet.
values.rejected: Validation found blockers. Fix them and draft again.
values.approved: A person approved it. It is indexed for search, then can be published.
values.publishing: Being made the release that Ask and Analytics serve.
values.published: The release being served now. It never changes.
values.superseded: Was published; a newer release has replaced it. Still available for rollback.
values.withdrawn: Taken out of service and will not be served again.

values.running: Papers are being extracted on the worker.
values.finished: Every paper in the run has been extracted, or skipped because nothing changed.

values.failed: Stopped with an error before its metrics were complete.
values.cancelled: Stopped by a person before it finished.
values.passed: Finished, and every threshold the benchmark sets was met.
values.failed gates: Finished, but at least one threshold the benchmark sets was not met.

values.discovery: Measures whether the scope's searches find the papers they should.
values.identity: Measures whether records of the same paper are joined correctly.
values.parsing: Measures the quality of the text read from documents.
values.extraction: Measures the accuracy of extracted values.
values.retrieval: Measures whether search returns the right papers for a question.
values.generation: Measures the answers Ask writes, for people to grade.
values.policy: Checks that restricted material is never shown to those who may not see it.

values.public: May be shared outside the lab.
values.restricted: Contains restricted material; only those who may see it can open it.

values.submitted: Graded. You can still update it.

values.invited: Invited but has not accepted yet.
values.active: Can sign in and use the pages their role allows.
values.suspended: Cannot sign in until an admin restores access.
values.expired: Their access ended on its expiry date.

values.open: Sent and not used yet; the link still works.
values.revoked: Cancelled by an admin; the link no longer works.
values.expired: Not used in time; the link no longer works.

values.pending: Waiting for the tasks it depends on.
values.ready: Ready to run; waiting for a free worker.
values.leased: Being worked on by a worker now.
values.blocked: Cannot run until something outside it changes.
values.awaiting_user: Waiting for a person, for example an upload or a decision. Not a failure.
values.degraded: Finished with part of its work missing.
values.quarantined: Set aside because its input failed a safety or integrity check.
values.failed: Failed this attempt; it is retried by its retry policy.
values.dead_letter: Failed every retry. It waits for an operator to retry it.

values.blinded: Its expected answers are hidden from those running and grading it.
values.required_for_publishing: A release must pass this benchmark before it can be published.
values.restricted: Withheld: your role may not see this figure.
values.excerpt_only: Only an excerpt of this source may be shown, not its full text.

values.session_revoked: A sign-in session was ended by an admin or a security rule.
values.password_changed: A password was set from the server's command line, which signs that person out everywhere.
values.invitation_accepted: Someone accepted an invitation and joined.
values.membership_changed: A member's role or status changed.
values.grant_changed: Access to a resource was granted or removed.
values.member_chat_read: An admin opened a member's conversation. Recorded on every read.
values.invitation_deleted: A revoked or expired invitation was removed from the list.
values.scope_approved: A scope version was approved for discovery.
values.scope_draft_deleted: An unapproved scope version was deleted.
values.scope_deleted: A whole scope was deleted, with every version, its discovery runs and the papers only it found.
values.discovery_run_started: A discovery run started searching its sources.
values.discovery_run_frozen: A discovery run was frozen and its results became candidates.
values.discovery_run_deleted: A discovery run that produced no candidates was deleted, with the pages it fetched.
values.degraded_source_accepted: A run was frozen although a source fell short, and the gap was accepted.
values.identity_decided: A person decided whether records are the same paper.
values.relevance_decided: A candidate was included or excluded.
values.relevance_bulk_decided: A steward included or excluded every candidate matching a filter, in one step.
values.identities_bulk_merged: A steward merged every duplicate pair a merge rule accepted, in one step.
values.duplicate_dismissed: A reviewer marked a proposed duplicate pair as two different papers.
values.scope_rules_applied: A steward re-applied an approved scope version's concepts and exclusion terms to the candidates.
values.rights_decided: What may be done with a paper's content was decided.
values.acquisition_attempted: A route was tried to fetch a paper's full text.
values.acquisition_requeued: Fetches waiting for a person were put back in the queue, to try their automatic routes again.
values.asset_quarantined: A file failed a safety check and was quarantined.
values.assisted_upload_accepted: A file a person uploaded was accepted.
values.rendition_accepted_degraded: A poorly read text was accepted for use anyway.
values.extraction_completed: Values were extracted from a paper.
values.proposal_rejected: An extracted value was rejected before review.
values.extraction_run_deleted: An extraction run in which no batch succeeded was deleted.
values.extraction_template_deleted: A draft extraction template that was never used was deleted.
values.claim_reviewed: A reviewer accepted, corrected or rejected a value.
values.release_draft_deleted: A draft or rejected release, never approved, was deleted.
values.release_approved: A release was approved and indexing started.
values.release_published: A release became the one being served.
values.release_rolled_back: Serving went back to the previous release.
values.release_withdrawn: A release was taken out of service.
values.benchmark_deleted: A benchmark version that no run had used was deleted.
values.evaluation_run_deleted: A failed or cancelled evaluation run was deleted.
values.evaluation_review_assigned: Answers were assigned to a reviewer to grade.
values.release_gate_changed: The benchmarks required for publishing changed.
values.release_gate_overridden: A release was published although a required benchmark had not passed.
values.citation_validation_failed: An answer cited something it was not allowed to, and the citation was removed.
values.asset_downloaded: A stored full-text file was downloaded.
values.policy_denied: An action was refused by policy.
values.task_dead_lettered: A background task failed every retry.
values.object_integrity_failed: A stored file no longer matched its recorded checksum.
values.admin_action: An admin performed a maintenance action.
values.installation_drained: This installation stopped publishing for a handover.
values.installation_promoted: This installation took over publishing the shared archive.
values.archive_purged: Archive files were deleted under a reviewed retention plan.
values.legacy_import_run: Data from the previous system was imported.
